audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTERS WXYZ WALK - the weasel p. 125, the webbird and the wemic p. 125, the black willow p. 126, the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing and the wolfwere p. 127, the tenebrous worm and the tunnel worm pp. 127-128 (the WORM family head, the two sub-entries), the xag-ya and xeg-yi p. 128, the xaren p. 129, the yeth hound and the yochlol (Handmaiden of Lolth) p. 129, the yuan ti p. 130, the juju zombie p. 130 and the monster zombie p. 131 (the two ZOMBIE heads), the zorbo p. 131 and the zygom pp. 131-132; the WXYZ-FLIP round: the Letter W, X, Y and Z gap boxes flip to closed and the Monsters from A-Z parent box flips to closed - 32 closed 5 open, the A-Z section complete.
